name: Nine Elms
notes: Luxury-flat OVERSUPPLY case study: empty units, multi-year listings, price cuts, low yield. Included as a what-NOT-to-buy comparator.

name: Acton
notes: Old Oak Common HS2/Elizabeth super-hub under construction (Europe's biggest regen, OPDC ~24k homes by 2040). Period W3 stock benefits from the catalyst without absorbing the new-build supply. Central line: 8 min White City, 33 min Bethnal Green.

name: Bow
notes: Central line at Mile End (Bethnal Green 1 stop / ~2 min), gentrification ripple from Hackney + Victoria Park. Period terraces and Victorian conversions; Roman Road regen ongoing. No mega-catalyst — steady established momentum.
